rationale.purpose: Provide the user-requested native handbook links, boss model viewing and compact quest navigation
rationale.decision_source: User explicitly requested removing Controls, JEI links for books and compatible equipment with five fixed slots and sixth-slot overflow, collapsed subquest groups and a boss model/description/drop spread. Codex chose native Patchouli custom components and entity pages, JEI focus with exact stack NBT, native applicability caching and one client constructor Mixin

notes: 55 of 56 authored boss profiles have confirmed possible-item links from primary native tables or reviewed death procedures. Fractured has no confirmed native drop source in the inspected evidence, so no item is invented
